comment.description: Saved-login autocomplete row (Firefox 154+ autocomplete-row-item). Matches the FIRST loginWithOrigin row and is NOT site-specific — the ac-value attribute was removed, so all such rows share this selector. Fine when the store holds a single login or the caller only needs any saved row; a caller that needs a particular credential must confirm the label via get_primary_value.
